body: Integration seat 2026-11-20 06:4x: S3 is PR #4362 (s3-red-main-watch -> integration, head 734a8839ae6), STRICT review requested. It implements the signed sketch plus the flake-damping amendment: the episode opens with an urgent mail and one re-run of the failed jobs; the fix spec and operator notice wait for confirmation (the red survives the re-run, or 30 min); a red cleared by a green re-run is outcome=flake. Revert is recommended once per reason (unbuildable, smoke-fail, fix_window, needs-design), never performed automatically. No keep_merging gate (Q1), and a test asserts that no merge path reads the watch. It runs in both modes (Q2). The only setting is [landing] red_main.fix_window. check-ci-fast exit 0; ci:full added after the push run started.
